title: Nine Towers of Stone
subtitle: 城堡与建筑 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城堡与建筑（文学艺术与体育·建筑艺术）
meta: 主题语境：城堡与建筑（文学艺术与体育·建筑艺术）　|　核心词汇：castle　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 castle 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1946 my mother was sent to draw ① a castle she could not enter, and she said the entering was the whole of the lesson. The ② castle, meaning the stone and not the family, was nine towers high and was drawn by whoever came last; a castle, she said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ castle in that valley had the same moat, and the ④ castle at the north, meaning the one the keeper kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever drawn properly. A castle, my grandmother said, is nine parts stone and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the stone is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ castle was the whole of the family, meaning the house it held and not the stone. The ⑥ castle, meaning the family and not any of that, is the only thing in a county that everybody visits and nobody questions; a castle, he said, is either something you draw or the only word that means both a stone and a family. She said the family is the part they remember.

By 1962 the ⑦ castle had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the moat. The ⑧ castle of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine towers and eleven years of drawing; a castle, she said, is either the one at the north or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ castle I remember is the one at the north, which was opened in 1967 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ castle, my grandmother said in 1972, is the only thing that improves by being visited; every castle, she said, is a family that has agreed to look like stone. She said the family was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 城堡（指那座石头建筑本身，与家族相对）
C. 固定搭配：draw a castle 画一座城堡
D. n. 城堡（指山谷里每一座）
E. n. 城堡（指北面那一座）
F. n. 城堡（抽象：它容纳的那个家族）
G. n. 那个家族（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a castle she could not enter
The castle, meaning the stone and not the family
castle was the whole of the family
the castle had become a photograph in a report
The castle of the whole thing
A castle, my grandmother said in 1972

answers.why: draw a castle 意为“画一座城堡”，1946 年母亲被派去画一座她进不去的城堡。
castle 意为“城堡”，指那座石头建筑本身而不是家族，有九座塔，由最后走的人画下。
castle 指山谷里每一座城堡，每一座都是同样的护城河。
castle 指北面那一座（看守人管的那一座），是唯一有人认真画过的。
castle 意为“城堡”，抽象指它容纳的那个家族，父亲说 castle 就是那个家族的全部。
castle 为抽象用法，指那个家族本身，是郡里人人都参观、却没人质疑的东西。
castle 意为“城堡”，到 1962 年这座 castle 成了报告里的一张照片。
castle 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九座塔和十一年的作画。
castle 意为“城堡”，我记得的是北面那一座，1967 年开放，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
castle 为抽象总称，祖母说城堡是唯一会因为有人来看它而变好的地方。
